ui.writeFirst.text: Write the letter first, then press Done.

ui.step.demo.text: Watch how the letter is written. The numbers show the order of the strokes.

ui.step.trace.text: Tracing: follow the pale letter, start at the green dot.

ui.step.copy.text: Copy {n} of {total}: write the same letter on the line below the model.

ui.step.memoryWriteDot.text: Start at the dot and write it from memory.

ui.step.memoryAided.text: Copy the letter from the model.

ui.step.memoryCompare.text: Compare your letter with the model.

ui.finished.text: Lesson finished: watch, trace, copy and write from memory.

fb.start.text: Start here, at the green dot.

fb.direction.text: Go the way the arrow points.

fb.order.text: Follow the numbers: stroke 1 first, then stroke 2.

fb.extraStroke.text: Try it in one movement, without lifting the pen.

fb.extraLine.text: There's an extra line here. Look at the model.

fb.missingStroke.text: A stroke is missing. Look at the numbers.

fb.retrace.text: Go back down the same line, not next to it.

fb.closed.text: Close the circle: come back to where it started.

fb.size.text: Watch the lines: the letter should reach them.

fb.baseline.text: Sit the letter on the bottom line.

fb.shape.text: Slow down and copy the shape of the model.

fb.deferredMissing.text: Don't forget the {part} after the letter.

fb.unrecognized.text: I couldn't quite see the letter. Please write it again.

praise.process.path.text: Right start and direction, and the strokes are in order.

praise.process.start.text: You started at the right point, and it worked.

praise.process.direction.text: You followed the arrows the right way.

praise.process.order.text: The strokes are in order, just right.

praise.process.strokes.text: All the strokes are in place.

praise.process.retrace.text: Back down the same line, just right.

praise.process.lines.text: The letter fits the lines now.

praise.process.shape.text: The shape is closer to the model now.
